column1: # Packages pinned by THIS repo rather than by precovid-repro's environment record.
# group=postbuild  the two packages that carry the data a panel is drawn from,
#                  at the versions that follow `make all` on precovid-repro.
#                  These are the pins that decide what a panel MEANS: the same
#                  script over v1.3 objects and over v2.0 objects produces two
#                  different figures with no visible difference in the code.
# group=delta      a package this repo pins itself because the reference
#                  manifest either lacks it — precovid-repro never loads it, so
#                  its record cannot pin it — or records a version this repo
#                  cannot use. Nothing in this repo reads this file; the
#                  versions each PDF was drawn from are recorded in
#                  outputs/panels/export_manifest.tsv.
# The package version and the collection version move independently, and the two
# rows below are at different package versions for that reason. Both are built
# from v2.0 collection objects, so extended_data_3/sex_da.env's SEX_DA_VERSION stays
# 2.0. Bump these rows for a package release; bump SEX_DA_VERSION only when the
# collection the objects were built FROM is rebuilt.
# Analysis 2.0.4 was not a formatting patch. It replaced the fuzzy c-means
# objects with blood clustered at k = 12 and re-annotated HUMAN_FEATURE_TO_GENE
# with the epigenomics peaks, so a table or panel built against 2.0.2 and one
# built against 2.0.4 differ in content, not appearance. ST4a is read straight
# out of FCM_ORA and is the clearest case.
# 2.0.5 carries that forward and adds to it. The thirteen *_DA objects gain
# CI.L_calculated and CI.R_calculated with no existing column or row changed,
# and PTMSEA_INPUT is new; neither reaches a panel in scope. UTORONTO_TFs changes
# shape - it is now the prot-ph TF regulator pool, 1,381 rows keyed by
# phosphosite, where it was 2,765 rows keyed by Ensembl gene - but no panel or
# sub-table in this repo reads it. Every panel built here has been drawn against
# 2.0.6 changes COVARIATES_FILE only: the methylcap BMI and codedsiteid rows are
# gone, as the MALAX model never used them. ST2a is the one table it reaches.
# 2.0.7 removes the vendored assay_codes snapshot and reads MotrpacBicQC live
# instead. FIG4 and ED5 are the only readers and already call
# MotrpacBicQC::assay_codes, so no panel moves. It also moves
# load_differential_analysis(epigen = TRUE) from the staging bucket to the
# public c2.0 CloudFront release; those files are byte-identical to the
# staging_20260806 objects the assembled figures were drawn from, so no panel
# moves either.
# 2.0.8 adds plot_enrich_heatmap(return_drawing = TRUE), which FIG4A, FIG4B and
# ED5A call in place of a vendored copy; same sets and page sizes as that copy.
# It raises the MotrpacBicQC floor to 2.0.0, adds gridtext to Imports and cmapR
# to Suggests.
# Data 2.0.3 adds feature_metadata columns to five QC objects: the four
# proteomics objects and BLOOD_METAB_T_CLINICAL_QC. No row and no existing
# column changes, so no panel or sub-table moves. load_qc(epigen = TRUE) reads
# gs://motrpac-data-hub/analysis/human-precovid-sed-adu/c2.0; a build from
# before 2026-09-24 reads the staging prefix under the same version number.
# The two postbuild rows are still blocking=no, which is now the only thing left
# to decide rather than a consequence of the sentinel: flipping them to yes turns
# the pin into the gate and demotes the export manifest to corroboration. Until
# then the fact the pin would assert is recorded a different way - every exported
# PDF carries the versions it was actually drawn from in
# outputs/panels/export_manifest.tsv (data_pkg_version, analysis_pkg_version),
# written by export_panel() at the moment of export, so a build is never
# mislabelled.
# The three delta rows are MotrpacBicQC, ggpubr and ggpubr's dependency rstatix.
# All three ARE in the reference manifest, at 1.9.0, 0.6.3 and 0.7.3, so they
# are the second case the delta group covers: pinned here INSTEAD of by the
# reference, because this repo needs a version the reference does not record.
# ggpubr is blocking. It is the only blocking row in this file, and it is
# blocking because the pin decides numbers rather than appearance - see its note.
# op is how the installed version is compared:  ==  exact,  >=  at least.
# columns: package  group  version  op  blocking  source  notes
package
MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData
column7: Individual-level data objects. 2.0.3 is the current head of the v2.0 line. It adds feature_metadata columns to five QC objects: confident_score, ptm_score and redundant_ids on ADIPOSE_PROT_PH_QC and MUSCLE_PROT_PH_QC; num_peptides, percent_coverage, protein_score and redundant_ids on ADIPOSE_PROT_PR_QC and MUSCLE_PROT_PR_QC; is_named, num_NAs and pct_na_imputed on BLOOD_METAB_T_CLINICAL_QC. No row and no existing column changed against 2.0.2, so no panel or sub-table built here moves. load_qc(epigen = TRUE) lists and reads gs://motrpac-data-hub/analysis/human-precovid-sed-adu/c2.0, caches under the repo_local_dir it is given, and stops when the gsutil listing fails. That is the installed build (commit 2306c55, 2026-09-24); a build from before 2026-09-24 reads the staging prefix under the same version number. Requires Analysis >= 2.0.8 and MotrpacBicQC >= 2.0.0.

column1: MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionAnalysis
column7: Summary / DA / enrichment objects, and the canonical colour, timepoint and tissue constants every panel draws from. Carries the FCM results with blood clustered at k = 12 (FCM_ORA, FCM_CLUSTERS, FCM_CAMERA) and HUMAN_FEATURE_TO_GENE with the epigenomics peak annotation, and from 2.0.7 reads the epigenomics DA from the public c2.0 CloudFront release, byte-identical to the staging_20260806 objects the assembled figures were drawn from. ST4a is built from FCM_ORA, so this pin decides its contents. 2.0.6 drops BMI and codedsiteid from the methylcap rows of COVARIATES_FILE, which ST2a lists. 2.0.7 removes the vendored assay_codes snapshot; FIG4 and ED5 already read MotrpacBicQC::assay_codes directly, so nothing here changes. 2.0.8 adds plot_enrich_heatmap(return_drawing = TRUE), which FIG4A, FIG4B and ED5A call in place of a vendored copy, and raises the MotrpacBicQC floor to 2.0.0.

column1: MotrpacBicQC
column7: Required at >= 2.0.0 by Analysis 2.0.8 and Data 2.0.3, both of which Remotes the v2.0.0 tag. FIG4 and ED5 read MotrpacBicQC::assay_codes, unchanged from 1.9.0. 2.0.0 drops the archived inspectdf import. The reference manifest records 1.9.0, which is why this row pins it. Installed at 2.0.0.

column1: ggpubr
column7: From 1.0.0, compare_means() adjusts p within each group.by level (upstream #200); through 0.6.3 it pooled across every row the call returned. Stage 08 calls it with group.by = "Timepoint", so 0.6.3 adjusts a tissue's 6 or 10 contrasts together and 1.0.0 adjusts the 2 at each timepoint. FIG4G and ED6E draw -log10 of that p as bubble area: 128 of ED6E's 154 cells move between the two versions and 8 cross the 0.05 outline. The reference manifest records 0.6.3, which is why this row pins it instead.

column1: rstatix
column7: Not imported by any script here; it is what ggpubr 1.0.0 requires. Installed at 1.1.0. The reference manifest records 0.7.3.
